title: Bias Attribution in Filipino Language Models: Extending a Bias Interpretability Metric for Application on Agglutinative Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing token probabilities of unmodified tokens masked within stereotypical versus less stereotypical contexts using the Filipino CrowS-Pairs benchmark and calculating an information-theoretic bias attribution score.
